title: Great and simple
body: I just downloaded the app and I love how simple and perfect it is. I used finch before and it was really great when I was younger, but now it was just overwhelming and a bit annoying. I love the simple interface and the aesthetic and the way that it’s FREE!

title: Great App!

title: Amazing

title: Simple and pretty habit tracker
body: I was always looking for a simple and easy habit tracker and this one is exactly it! You can add habits, add a daily reminder and have a nice overview. The design is simple and pretty. And the best thing: there are no ads! But you can leave a tip, which is very nice ✨
